_about: Short pixel effects on a tool's hit (ToolFxRules; the 3D view's ToolFxLayer, the flat view's ToolFxView). A swing plays the farmer's swing_<tool> pose (FigureArt): `swing.windup` seconds raised, then the blow (the hit frame) for `swing.blow` seconds; the effect starts on the blow, the farmer stands still for the whole swing. The cell's rule (FarmGrid / MineFloor), the tool's sound and the bits all land on the hit; the stamina is paid on the press. Holding the button to charge shows the wind-up frame. Seeds have a scatter pose (`swing_seeds`: the hand back at the pouch, then out with seeds falling) and `seeds` bits: let go at `drop` cells up, spread `spread` cells round each cell sown, started up to `stagger` s apart. `kinds`: what flies. Units are cells (1 cell = 1 world unit = 16 flat px) and seconds: `count` bits per cell, `speed` the sideways speed range, `up` the upward speed range, `gravity`, `bounce` (the share of the fall speed kept on hitting the ground; 0 = stays), `life` range, `size` range in sprite pixels (3D: FarmWorld.PX each), `colors` picked at random. A puff is a soft blob that grows `grow` times and rises `rise`; a ring (where a drop lands) grows to `radius`; a spark flies fast and short; a glint sits and twinkles. `per_level`: each tool level past 1 adds this share of the count (level 5 = 1.6x). `max_particles`: one swing never throws more, the counts are scaled down to fit. `fade`: the last share of a life fades out. `ground`: soil colours for the hoe by the ground: dry (the tilled tile's tones), wet (the dry ones in wet.json's `tilled` wet tone by the wetness; from `wet_from` wetness on, or on a watered cell), snow (snow lying outdoors: a blue-grey snow, darker than the lying snow's eff4fb so the lumps read on white, and a soil brown); `mine` the cave's soft soil. A missed or useless swing gives only a puff of `puff.dust` (in snow `puff.snow`, wet ground `puff.wet`) on the first cell. `flat.height_px`: in the flat view a cell of height lifts a bit this many px up the screen. Numbers are ours.
